votes.evidence_summary: HTTP 200 accepting 3-dim vector in asynchronous mode while HTTP 400 correctly rejecting it in synchronous mode with wait=true
votes.rationale: Log shows intermittent validation behavior: PUT with vector=[0.1,0.2,0.3] and wait=true correctly rejected with HTTP 400 'Vector dimension error: expected dim: 4, got 3', but same request without wait=true accepted with HTTP 200/acknowledged; API inconsistently validates vector dimension between synchronous and asynchronous modes, violating contract that wrong-dimension vectors should be rejected
